title: The big green candle
situation: You are scrolling through charts in the simulator when a big green candle appears on gold. Without checking your plan, you open the order ticket. You have not set a [[stop-loss|stop loss]] or worked out your size.
question: What do you do next?

responses.text: Cancel the ticket and run your pre-trade checklist. If the setup passes, enter with a stop and a size you worked out.
responses.explanation: A short pause turns a sudden urge into a decision you can explain and review later.

responses.text: Enter now and add the stop later, once you see where price goes.
responses.explanation: Without a stop, the trade has no planned limit. "Later" often comes after price has already moved against you.

responses.text: Enter with your smallest [[lot]] size so it does not matter.
responses.explanation: Small size limits the damage, but it still rewards the habit of entering without a plan.

takeaway: A short pause and a checklist turn a sudden urge into a decision you can review.
